description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain names of the website services.

> The domain names must have forwarding rules configured for website services. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The resource group ID of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance in Resource Management. The default value is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 查询网站业务区域封禁配置信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-web-area-block-configs --resource-group-id default --domains www.aliyun00.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
